title: The Robbers' Barrow
objective: Find what the goblin robbers left in the old barrow, and get out alive. Leave by the way you came in when you are ready.

rooms.name: Barrow Mouth
rooms.description: A low doorway of fitted stones opens onto the hillside. Daylight reaches a few steps in and no further.

features.name: Scratched Lintel
features.description: The stone over the doorway is scored with fresh knife marks.
features.discovery: Someone has scratched a warning into the stone: "Goblin on the bier. Silver underneath."

rooms.name: Burial Hall
rooms.description: A long, low hall of packed earth and old bones. A stone bier stands at the far end under a rotted cloth.

features.name: Stone Bier
features.description: A waist-high slab of grey stone, draped in cloth gone black with age.
features.discovery: Beneath the rotted cloth lies a neck ring of twisted silver that the robbers missed.

items.name: Silver Torc
items.description: A neck ring of twisted silver, heavy and cold.

items.name: Pouch of Old Coins
items.description: A greasy leather pouch of tarnished coins, robbed from the barrow's dead.

passages.description: A short passage slopes down into the dark.

opponents.name: Goblin Warrior
opponents.description: A goblin crouches on the bier, picking through the grave goods, and leaps down with its scimitar drawn.

endings.title: Out with the silver
endings.text: You climb back into the daylight with the barrow's treasure heavy in your pack.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You climb back into the daylight with nothing to show for the barrow but dust.

endings.title: Fallen in the barrow
endings.text: You fall among the old bones. Your adventuring ends here.
